Audit2246: native USB arm inventory, nested hubs and saved bindings

Prepared for @HOST@, native @PLATFORM@ Agent, explicit CLI target @TARGET@.
Selected endpoint @ID@ at @PORT@; owned saved name @NAME@.
All cases start not_run. Generation reads saved files only. USB metadata does
not prove the arm model, motor state, access permission, calibration or identity.
This procedure never opens a serial device, moves a motor or deploys an app.

Required acceptance matrix

Use four independently recorded plans: macOS and Linux, each with a uniquely
serial-identified adapter and a separate adapter with no serial ID. Each target
must have two physically nested USB hubs. A missing host, adapter or topology
leaves that case not_run. A USB passthrough VM or constructed metadata does not
substitute for either native host. No Windows arm-inventory support is claimed.

Prepare inventory.json with platform, hostname, explicit target selector,
os_version, agent_version, owner and timezone-qualified captured_at. Include
adapter fields id, device_path, vendor_id, product_id, serial_number (empty string
if absent), usb_location, usb_interface and physical_label. Include nested_hubs,
in physical ancestry order, each with physical_label, native_location, vendor_id
and product_id. Include paths cli, agent_binary, native_inventory, baseline_list,
authorization and restart_procedure. These must be saved regular files.
The baseline_list is the actual target Agent response from:
  /absolute/candidate/wendy --device EXACT_TARGET --json device pair --usb-arms --list
Capture it with the bounded Python pattern in step3, substituting this explicit
argv before plan generation. Save stdout, stderr and the exit/timeout record.
The native_inventory must preserve full ancestry, not just a flat device list.
The CLI/Agent binaries must be the exact candidate build from a reviewed source;
keep build/signature records and compare their hashes to plan.json before runs.

Generate a NEW directory outside Git:
  python3 .github/regression-coverage/manual/usb-arm-inventory-rehearsal.py prepare inventory.json /absolute/new-plan

1. Reserve the exact native host, two hubs and physically labelled adapter.
   The authorization record must allow one new host-local USB binding and an
   Agent restart using the owner's exact already-reviewed restart procedure.
   No existing binding for this endpoint is allowed; preserve all other bindings.
   Keep motor power disconnected where the owner's hardware procedure permits;
   support the arm and do not change torque or bus ownership. Stop if another
   experiment relies on this host or adapter. Use existing CLI authentication;
   do not change trust stores, install drivers, force pairing or use insecure TLS.

2. Independently verify host/Agent identity at the target's console, including
   hostname, OS, candidate binary hash, process path/version and service identity.
   On macOS use the native Swift Agent, not a Go Agent built for macOS. Preserve
   its signature/build record. Confirm the explicit CLI target reaches that host.
   Save full native topology and tty association before every topology change:
     macOS: /usr/sbin/ioreg -a -l -r -c IOUSBHostDevice
            /usr/sbin/ioreg -a -l -r -c IOSerialBSDClient
     Linux: lsusb -t
            udevadm info --attribute-walk --name EXACT_SELECTED_TTY
            udevadm info --query=property --name EXACT_SELECTED_TTY
   Run only the selected platform commands. Do not glob tty paths or open them.
   Compare both hub ancestors and endpoint VID/PID/serial/interface/location to
   physical labels and the Agent's list. Reject duplicate serial identities or
   ambiguous endpoints. A hash proves retained bytes, not physical ancestry.

3. Capture each exact CLI command below individually, with a25-second outer
   bound. The RPC already has a15-second bound. A portable way to capture is:
     python3 - <<'PY'
     import json,subprocess
     from pathlib import Path
     p=json.loads(Path('/absolute/new-plan/plan.json').read_text())
     root=Path('/absolute/new-evidence'); stem='baseline'
     with (root/(stem+'.json')).open('xb') as out, (root/(stem+'.stderr')).open('xb') as err:
         try:
             result=subprocess.run(p['commands']['list'],stdout=out,stderr=err,timeout=25)
             status={'exit_code':result.returncode,'timed_out':False}
         except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
             status={'exit_code':None,'timed_out':True}
     with (root/(stem+'.result.json')).open('x') as record:
         json.dump(status,record)
     print(status)
     PY
   Create the private new-evidence directory first. Change the unique stem
   and command key explicitly for each step; never overwrite earlier evidence.
   Inspect CLI/Agent hashes and plan commands before execution. On timeout or
   nonzero exit retain stderr/result and stop; do not count a partial JSON file.
   Generation requires selected baseline connected=true, configured=false,
   verified=false. An existing binding requires a different reserved adapter.

4. Bind the exact endpoint with the generated bind command. This writes only
   the owned host-local binding. For a serial-less adapter FIRST execute
   refuse-location-bind without acknowledgment: it must fail with the explicit
   missing-serial/location acknowledgment error, and a fresh list must show no
   configured binding. Then use the generated acknowledged bind command. This
   acknowledges that replacements at the same port cannot be distinguished.
   Save bind reply and a fresh bound.json list. Require the exact name @NAME@,
   model so101, configured=true, verified=false and access_status=unknown.
   Check API observations with:
     python3 .github/regression-coverage/manual/usb-arm-inventory-rehearsal.py check /absolute/new-plan/plan.json bound /absolute/new-evidence/bound.json
   The checker never marks hardware passed; native identity review is separate.

5. Unplug ONLY the selected USB data connection. Within10 seconds capture a
   fresh list: the saved ID/name must remain, connected=false,
   connection_status=disconnected and device_path empty. Verify phase disconnected.
   Reconnect to the same physical nested-hub port; preserve new native inventory
   and require the same ID/name configured and present. Verify phase bound.
   Fail if a stale tty path is presented as connected while physically absent.

6. Serial-identified adapter: move it through the reserved alternate hub port.
   Arrange a genuine tty renumber with a second owner-reserved unrelated adapter
   if needed; never rename device nodes or mutate sysfs/IORegistry. Independently
   identify both adapters. Require actual changed native tty AND USB location,
   unchanged serial/interface identity and exactly one saved ID/name. Verify
   phase renumbered. If the OS reuses the original tty, retain this case not_run
   until a genuine renumber occurs; same-path replug is a different case.

   Serial-less adapter: moving ports MUST produce a new unconfigured location
   identity while the original saved ID/name stays disconnected with empty path.
   Verify phase relocated-location. Do not claim its name follows the adapter.
   Return the same physically labelled adapter to its original port, inspect its
   actual ancestry and require the original saved name there. Verify phase bound.
   This intentional port-following behavior cannot authenticate a replacement.

7. Execute rebind with no new --arm-name. Capture a fresh list and require the
   original owned name, not the default SO-101 name. Verify phase bound. Restart
   only the reserved candidate Agent using the exact approved restart_procedure.
   Record old/new process identity; require actual process exit and a new process
   with the same candidate hash/version. On Mac use its supported lifecycle,
   not a broad killall. Within60 seconds require fresh list transport success and
   the same configured/unverified name and current native endpoint. Verify phase
   restarted. Do not infer persistence from a cached client or same live process.

8. Execute forget for ONLY @ID@ after verifying it still has @NAME@. Capture a
   fresh list while the selected adapter is connected: configured=false,
   verified=false, inventory still present. Verify phase forgotten. Compare every
   unrelated saved binding ID/name/model to the baseline. Leave unknown or newly
   changed state for its owner; never delete the whole bindings file. Restore
   only the reserved physical cable topology and retain all evidence privately.

Record each outcome with native inventory, before/after CLI JSON, binary hashes,
process restart evidence, timestamps and independent reviewer. A refusal,
ambiguous identity, missing hardware, timeout or failed cleanup is not a pass.
No motor calibration, serial I/O, reader reattachment or arm control is covered;
audit2247 has its separate native physical reader procedure.
